in_hebrew.name: Grefer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Grefer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'Geras' meaning 'venerable' and 'phero' meaning 'to bear'. A strong bearer of respect and honor.

in_greek.name: Grefer
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong bearer
in_greek.long_meaning: Grefer είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'Geras' meaning 'venerable' and 'phero' meaning 'to bear'. A strong bearer of respect and honor.

in_latin.name: Grefer
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong bearer
in_latin.long_meaning: Grefer est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek word 'Geras' meaning 'venerable' and 'phero' meaning 'to bear'. A strong bearer of respect and honor.
